Heavy or regular drinking tends to elevate cortisol over time and disrupt how the body responds to and recovers from stress.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXJkjR67UokTdnvbNwLwkYv4jWQr2I8iqwuIbn0KRChe1fOXLINjBWHs6ulVT1uzlLqvkk3RNmHijxXP623esyF5eXJySeDBEMrqyAfhzcbJPIRBSSCB1lMdDI7I9IAafEBoGhtCQYsw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXC7YQ3c9GcI-EqsYpX3CaLDTnyxU2FUnY8ykvLCpvh9rxsiGFlgVFwO5O6hNXIJKqrK6Gm4FBzAIkoPNX2wzxd2Gxwz19Kdp_huEBagHblzlQ55Egl0gl8XYA0PRnl5F4j3KliNlR3vk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXX9M6NxHGg84WhnWr7SGUYtbL2N8mSMcJ3p_vpSYpuUZPSPnNd8CNyyyQ95hh5so0OcsyWZ4q3LOkhu-csZTK9Km1M2qS7iGNkugHyfSpQLzolGJ935wQlmepB2rwbHlJMcx2n7RQ1iT7C_Mk-VZbHEcg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-vZurMPuHPyM9bS0GP5q13VvXyxIutiP-XQX1G3PDOc_qQ7FHkrCCGx3BuWfDuEx_pJ6E2_3GepIJvH7K6nyRbT9vWFHmDDIWiWllHtnDtBPXBSjTFWvnxbWc6c-0WDX0jPrKl5Vi2yrV-DzGOoGsjSZ8BZJ7tDVv4dmy3V5GYA)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXTtS2_Z55MX0cRfHue6STd8kBeyQAaouedSHhQ8LwuJZAmP8FYy2h1Og_Nd6jz2LPJETnzA5XJOSA5E6YVahfOFPACQBb-n7bbhTNebXYRmZqeYmvA-HoxoZFvPnK7gPsJ-_Jd6-JCJ0)

### Short-Term vs. Long-Term Effects

- **Short-term response:** Drinking alcohol can trigger the HPA axis and alter cortisol release, though individual responses vary based on dose, genetics, family history, and whether alcohol is consumed alongside stress or food. While alcohol often feels relaxing at first, it can also interfere with sleep and stress recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXDrGboc6DxV_z-7I3blxma0wQplaAV53COYaoJw3RlS8pJwTDTDyqPljJw7NZ_QkcVwThjOlZvA5OIQxJmxlD7NlYXnVHLHeIOnJ7L1RhoGI4qIL6NklgmIiRO1XdxgGwmLJu1k8oAw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXJkjR67UokTdnvbNwLwkYv4jWQr2I8iqwuIbn0KRChe1fOXLINjBWHs6ulVT1uzlLqvkk3RNmHijxXP623esyF5eXJySeDBEMrqyAfhzcbJPIRBSSCB1lMdDI7I9IAafEBoGhtCQYsw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXTtS2_Z55MX0cRfHue6STd8kBeyQAaouedSHhQ8LwuJZAmP8FYy2h1Og_Nd6jz2LPJETnzA5XJOSA5E6YVahfOFPACQBb-n7bbhTNebXYRmZqeYmvA-HoxoZFvPnK7gPsJ-_Jd6-JCJ0)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX4qeHXKp0scMiav5w0o0l7aCaGqixC3-4-v2bWg81kvX7oE3ZD2d2EKlvk8ALx3juBAlCE2vI0vashW-2j--hn4fiu2ukX5LBTwTWQzQ2jerqDdrmDW51W7ej-tMKb4PcNajazjupFQ)
- **Chronic or heavy drinking:** Regular heavy or binge drinking can lead to elevated baseline cortisol levels and impair HPA axis regulation . Over time, the body's cortisol response to new stressors can become blunted or slower to return to baseline.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXhGpHHCI94RMtywb9SqMfw5EfGn3DgMyqShMFllz1LjraL6W4q-NADdZGI1x782ZCIyNeUXchsg9f6SaTC48uANZXRS87bXUoi5jZ9YNCvkuEJ-nalpsMsFVUZX07JSBOBP7q-h5xTgooazLfvdNi32owcfcKRe-sfg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXX9M6NxHGg84WhnWr7SGUYtbL2N8mSMcJ3p_vpSYpuUZPSPnNd8CNyyyQ95hh5so0OcsyWZ4q3LOkhu-csZTK9Km1M2qS7iGNkugHyfSpQLzolGJ935wQlmepB2rwbHlJMcx2n7RQ1iT7C_Mk-VZbHEcg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-vZurMPuHPyM9bS0GP5q13VvXyxIutiP-XQX1G3PDOc_qQ7FHkrCCGx3BuWfDuEx_pJ6E2_3GepIJvH7K6nyRbT9vWFHmDDIWiWllHtnDtBPXBSjTFWvnxbWc6c-0WDX0jPrKl5Vi2yrV-DzGOoGsjSZ8BZJ7tDVv4dmy3V5GYA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXTtS2_Z55MX0cRfHue6STd8kBeyQAaouedSHhQ8LwuJZAmP8FYy2h1Og_Nd6jz2LPJETnzA5XJOSA5E6YVahfOFPACQBb-n7bbhTNebXYRmZqeYmvA-HoxoZFvPnK7gPsJ-_Jd6-JCJ0)
- **Withdrawal:** Cortisol levels can spike sharply during alcohol withdrawal, contributing to heightened stress, anxiety, and physical discomfort.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXC7YQ3c9GcI-EqsYpX3CaLDTnyxU2FUnY8ykvLCpvh9rxsiGFlgVFwO5O6hNXIJKqrK6Gm4FBzAIkoPNX2wzxd2Gxwz19Kdp_huEBagHblzlQ55Egl0gl8XYA0PRnl5F4j3KliNlR3vk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-vZurMPuHPyM9bS0GP5q13VvXyxIutiP-XQX1G3PDOc_qQ7FHkrCCGx3BuWfDuEx_pJ6E2_3GepIJvH7K6nyRbT9vWFHmDDIWiWllHtnDtBPXBSjTFWvnxbWc6c-0WDX0jPrKl5Vi2yrV-DzGOoGsjSZ8BZJ7tDVv4dmy3V5GYA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXl7bJynIGC6EbRP6NGJk__HDsYwJynyR0jQvbgWQfLiKaaVCG0r5iOEXIDX7nsc0waYrsA53316yqB-4uuCyYxjxiRs7R5pRnP08lyt57rx4EtrFEWgNgZaHr5cfaYAQWQz7wnqBy)

### Two-Way Cycle with Stress

- **Cortisol and cravings:** Stress and altered cortisol signaling can intensify cravings and make alcohol feel more rewarding, creating a loop where people drink to cope with stress that alcohol eventually worsens.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-vZurMPuHPyM9bS0GP5q13VvXyxIutiP-XQX1G3PDOc_qQ7FHkrCCGx3BuWfDuEx_pJ6E2_3GepIJvH7K6nyRbT9vWFHmDDIWiWllHtnDtBPXBSjTFWvnxbWc6c-0WDX0jPrKl5Vi2yrV-DzGOoGsjSZ8BZJ7tDVv4dmy3V5GYA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXJkjR67UokTdnvbNwLwkYv4jWQr2I8iqwuIbn0KRChe1fOXLINjBWHs6ulVT1uzlLqvkk3RNmHijxXP623esyF5eXJySeDBEMrqyAfhzcbJPIRBSSCB1lMdDI7I9IAafEBoGhtCQYsw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXX9M6NxHGg84WhnWr7SGUYtbL2N8mSMcJ3p_vpSYpuUZPSPnNd8CNyyyQ95hh5so0OcsyWZ4q3LOkhu-csZTK9Km1M2qS7iGNkugHyfSpQLzolGJ935wQlmepB2rwbHlJMcx2n7RQ1iT7C_Mk-VZbHEcg)
- **Health impacts:** Chronically high cortisol and HPA axis dysregulation are linked to higher blood pressure, blood sugar and metabolic strain, poor sleep, lowered immunity, fatigue, and mood changes. Research reviewed by [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXJkjR67UokTdnvbNwLwkYv4jWQr2I8iqwuIbn0KRChe1fOXLINjBWHs6ulVT1uzlLqvkk3RNmHijxXP623esyF5eXJySeDBEMrqyAfhzcbJPIRBSSCB1lMdDI7I9IAafEBoGhtCQYsw) details how alcohol, cortisol, and aging interact over time, while a [Mendelian randomization study on PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrsXpgIZKlP58cLcjYBdyKcws_HqM5aF-XzCJf7Iqm1X1LYnX-xfHrnUxFjx42SXBDCvAl8Vkxd4CwFfKZ08S620YKtx3i_BD1jLP7ISx2gKLUe3eaD7h1tuZZ1ObZqlLTN7RoDpA6g) examines genetic links between alcohol intake and serum cortisol. For support with drinking habits or stress management, Discovery Institute outlines evaluation and treatment options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrsXpgIZKlP58cLcjYBdyKcws_HqM5aF-XzCJf7Iqm1X1LYnX-xfHrnUxFjx42SXBDCvAl8Vkxd4CwFfKZ08S620YKtx3i_BD1jLP7ISx2gKLUe3eaD7h1tuZZ1ObZqlLTN7RoDpA6g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXC7YQ3c9GcI-EqsYpX3CaLDTnyxU2FUnY8ykvLCpvh9rxsiGFlgVFwO5O6hNXIJKqrK6Gm4FBzAIkoPNX2wzxd2Gxwz19Kdp_huEBagHblzlQ55Egl0gl8XYA0PRnl5F4j3KliNlR3vk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF11HnBIswFLHnF8ORrlFxEkn_xRMdLQdgq6bTmhoUg1k9VVdAankb0ROlWF-dkrm2VXWqFfMG-4B4chdgfxVOBsrT6jiuW9kCwD6xlWTfgs_Z_Gt5Vm7E6_CFw3BYi5R-d4QTMIaaV0YufCwsIM6JlIwtZmtozJhxDDltmG-d4j4HgmMW)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-vZurMPuHPyM9bS0GP5q13VvXyxIutiP-XQX1G3PDOc_qQ7FHkrCCGx3BuWfDuEx_pJ6E2_3GepIJvH7K6nyRbT9vWFHmDDIWiWllHtnDtBPXBSjTFWvnxbWc6c-0WDX0jPrKl5Vi2yrV-DzGOoGsjSZ8BZJ7tDVv4dmy3V5GYA)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXJkjR67UokTdnvbNwLwkYv4jWQr2I8iqwuIbn0KRChe1fOXLINjBWHs6ulVT1uzlLqvkk3RNmHijxXP623esyF5eXJySeDBEMrqyAfhzcbJPIRBSSCB1lMdDI7I9IAafEBoGhtCQYsw)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXDrGboc6DxV_z-7I3blxma0wQplaAV53COYaoJw3RlS8pJwTDTDyqPljJw7NZ_QkcVwThjOlZvA5OIQxJmxlD7NlYXnVHLHeIOnJ7L1RhoGI4qIL6NklgmIiRO1XdxgGwmLJu1k8oAw)

- **Health impacts:** Chronically high cortisol and HPA axis dysregulation are linked to higher blood pressure, blood sugar and metabolic strain, poor sleep, lowered immunity, fatigue, and mood changes. Research reviewed by [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXJkjR67UokTdnvbNwLwkYv4jWQr2I8iqwuIbn0KRChe1fOXLINjBWHs6ulVT1uzlLqvkk3RNmHijxXP623esyF5eXJySeDBEMrqyAfhzcbJPIRBSSCB1lMdDI7I9IAafEBoGhtCQYsw) details how alcohol, cortisol, and aging interact over time, while a [Mendelian randomization study on PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrsXpgIZKlP58cLcjYBdyKcws_HqM5aF-XzCJf7Iqm1X1LYnX-xfHrnUxFjx42SXBDCvAl8Vkxd4CwFfKZ08S620YKtx3i_BD1jLP7ISx2gKLUe3eaD7h1tuZZ1ObZqlLTN7RoDpA6g) examines genetic links between alcohol intake and serum cortisol. For support with drinking habits or stress management, Discovery Institute outlines evaluation and treatment options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrsXpgIZKlP58cLcjYBdyKcws_HqM5aF-XzCJf7Iqm1X1LYnX-xfHrnUxFjx42SXBDCvAl8Vkxd4CwFfKZ08S620YKtx3i_BD1jLP7ISx2gKLUe3eaD7h1tuZZ1ObZqlLTN7RoDpA6g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXC7YQ3c9GcI-EqsYpX3CaLDTnyxU2FUnY8ykvLCpvh9rxsiGFlgVFwO5O6hNXIJKqrK6Gm4FBzAIkoPNX2wzxd2Gxwz19Kdp_huEBagHblzlQ55Egl0gl8XYA0PRnl5F4j3KliNlR3vk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF11HnBIswFLHnF8ORrlFxEkn_xRMdLQdgq6bTmhoUg1k9VVdAankb0ROlWF-dkrm2VXWqFfMG-4B4chdgfxVOBsrT6jiuW9kCwD6xlWTfgs_Z_Gt5Vm7E6_CFw3BYi5R-d4QTMIaaV0YufCwsIM6JlIwtZmtozJhxDDltmG-d4j4HgmMW)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-vZurMPuHPyM9bS0GP5q13VvXyxIutiP-XQX1G3PDOc_qQ7FHkrCCGx3BuWfDuEx_pJ6E2_3GepIJvH7K6nyRbT9vWFHmDDIWiWllHtnDtBPXBSjTFWvnxbWc6c-0WDX0jPrKl5Vi2yrV-DzGOoGsjSZ8BZJ7tDVv4dmy3V5GYA)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXJkjR67UokTdnvbNwLwkYv4jWQr2I8iqwuIbn0KRChe1fOXLINjBWHs6ulVT1uzlLqvkk3RNmHijxXP623esyF5eXJySeDBEMrqyAfhzcbJPIRBSSCB1lMdDI7I9IAafEBoGhtCQYsw)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXDrGboc6DxV_z-7I3blxma0wQplaAV53COYaoJw3RlS8pJwTDTDyqPljJw7NZ_QkcVwThjOlZvA5OIQxJmxlD7NlYXnVHLHeIOnJ7L1RhoGI4qIL6NklgmIiRO1XdxgGwmLJu1k8oAw)
